author: WP13
summary: Alpha.1-era chapter on the shared glTF import core: parser and validation boundary, scene flattening, mesh groups, unit scale, extraction, the extension registry and failure/lifetime rules. Mostly still true in shape, but stale in detail: the core is three times larger, the offline orchestration is reused by cna-content and gltf_to_cnb, no-scene files walk root nodes, effects are shared, samplers are imported, missing normals are computed and Load<T> now wraps extraction errors in ContentLoadException. The site had the user-level limits table; the internals now live on the glTF import deep dive.

sections.heading: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: CNA has one shared glTF import library, CNA::Internal::GltfImport, rather than a small reader hidden inside ContentManager; its parsing and semantic extraction are shared by the runtime reader and the offline conversion.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: What is shared is interpretation; turning records into live graphics objects (runtime) or into persistent CNJ sidecars (offline) is not shared.
tokens: What is not shared is the last step

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: The offline glTF-to-CNJ orchestration is compiled into cna_content with CNA_GLTF_TO_CNJ_NO_MAIN, so cna-content and cna_tool_gltf_to_cnb call the same ConvertGltfToCnj as the standalone converter.
concepts.note: The claim named two front ends; at TARGET the offline orchestration has three callers.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: The core is about 2,200 header lines and 5,400 source lines at TARGET, not about 2,500 lines in total.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: Container parsing and accessor decoding are delegated to the vendored cgltf 1.15 single-header library.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: Exactly one translation unit (GltfImportCore.cpp) defines CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION; every other consumer links against it.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: stb_image and stb_image_write are compiled STATIC in that unit so their symbols have internal linkage and cannot collide with the graphics module's own vendored stb implementation.
concepts.note: The other copy at TARGET is CNA's own ImageLoader, not SDL image support.

concepts.section: From glTF File to Model: the Import Core
concepts.text: Tests pin that the vendored cgltf header is unmodified and that each known cgltf fault has a CNA-side answer.
Both JSON .gltf and binary .glb enter through the same cgltf_parse_file path; there is no separate container code.
The runtime reader installs CNA file callbacks so the document and external files open as UTF-8 paths rather than through the ANSI code page on Windows.
asset.version must equal 2.0 only when present; the check is conditional, so a document without the field can pass if cgltf accepts it; asset.minVersion is not inspected.
Buffers and images may be embedded buffer views, base64 data URIs or contained percent-decoded external files; images are memory blocks decoded without temporary files.
External URIs pass through ResolveExternalUriEXT, which refuses schemes, drive-absolute and root-absolute paths, lexical escapes and symlink escapes, comparing containment component-wise.
Containment runs before cgltf_load_buffers because that call resolves external buffer URIs itself with no veto hook.

A structural gate runs before semantic extraction: metadata-only alignment and overflow-safe span checks precede cgltf_validate, because the vendored validator can itself dereference misaligned index data.
A declared byteStride that is not a multiple of 4 is refused, and a bufferView whose offset plus length overflows is refused.
The importer cross-checks authored accessor min/max against decoded float values and warns on a disagreement beyond rounding tolerance.
Undecoded EXT_meshopt_compression is refused, every unclaimed extensionsRequired entry is rejected by name, and unclaimed extensionsUsed entries produce warnings with the registry note.
On the runtime path validation failures become ContentLoadException and warnings go to the log and the import report.

CNA's gate is stronger than syntax parsing but not a replacement for the independently pinned Khronos validator; run the Khronos validator before shipping third-party content — a successful load proves only the paths it used.
BuildSceneGraph selects the default scene, else the first scene; a file with no scenes is walked from every root node so meshes keep their authored placement.
tokens: walks every root node of the file
concepts.note: The no-scenes case now walks root nodes instead of producing an empty graph.

concepts.text: The walk is iterative (explicit stack), parent before child, preserving the file's child order; index 0 is a synthetic identity node named Root and each reachable node follows once, at the first path found.
Local matrices come from cgltf_node_transform_local (matrix-or-TRS rule), are converted to row-vector convention, and composed as W(i) = L(i) * W(parent(i)).
No axis or handedness conversion is applied, correctly: glTF and XNA conventions are both right-handed, +Y up, -Z forward with a top-left UV origin; only a tangent's w is imported as handedness.
tokens: No axis or handedness conversion is applied

concepts.text: Each flattened node becomes a ModelBone index-for-index after the synthetic root; vertex positions stay mesh-local so a mesh instanced by two nodes yields two ModelMesh placements with different parent bones.

A rigid mesh is parented to its instancing node; a skinned mesh's node still exists as a bone but the mesh is parented to the synthetic root, because the joint matrices already account for the mesh node's space.
Nodes unreachable from the selected scene do not enter the graph; if no reachable node references a mesh, CollectMeshGroups falls back to exposing every mesh unplaced at the identity root.
tokens: falls back to exposing every mesh

concepts.text: CollectMeshGroups partitions placements into one group per distinct skin plus one unskinned group, in node-array order; each placement records node, mesh, scene-node index, world transform, skinned flag and mirroring.
The offline route writes each group as a separate .cnj model with stable _static or _<skinName> suffixes; colliding sanitized names are refused.

The runtime path assembles every group into one Model; SkinsEXT maps each skin to its meshes and Tag remains a compatibility alias for the first skin, avoiding both the old groups.front() loss and posing every mesh with one palette.
tokens: Tag remains a compatibility alias for the first skin

concepts.text: The runtime effect cache keys on the skin, so two skins never share one mutable palette.
A stale source comment above ReadGltfModel still describes first-group-only import; the code imports every group.

unitScale multiplies translation-bearing quantities (positions, bind and inverse-bind translations, ancestor terms, animation translations and tangents, morph position deltas, camera placements) but never rotations or scale factors.
Runtime import fixes unitScale at 1.0; only the command-line converters expose it (gltf_to_cnj argument, gltf_to_cnb --unit-scale); cna-content has none.
ExtractMesh produces an explicit semantic record per primitive before any graphics object exists.
Every attribute of a primitive must have POSITION's element count; a mismatch is refused because POSITION drives the loop that indexes every stream.
tokens: the same element count as POSITION

concepts.text: Extraction decodes positions, normals, tangents, two UV sets, COLOR_0, JOINTS_0 and WEIGHTS_0 with offsets, strides, normalization and sparse overrides, including sparse accessors without a base view.
tokens: sparse accessor with no base buffer view

concepts.text: Indices are validated, a non-indexed primitive gets the implicit sequence, and tangents are generated for PBR primitives without authored tangents.
tokens: generates a tangent basis for PBR primitives
concepts.note: Tangents are generated for every PBR-layout primitive lacking them, not only normal-mapped materials.

concepts.text: Missing normals are computed as flat normals with vertex splitting, and authored tangents are then ignored as the specification requires.
Joint weights not summing to 1 are renormalised, all-zero weights stay unweighted, only the first influence set is kept, and each is reported with a count and worst magnitude.
Custom _* attributes are ignored by design and colour sets past COLOR_0 are dropped with a report entry; legacy _TANGENT/_BINORMAL pairs import as a tangent.

The factor-only material defect D7 is fixed: the effect is chosen by material model, so default, factor-only, normal-map-only and vertex-coloured metallic-roughness materials all use PbrEffect/SkinnedPbrEffect.
Only KHR_materials_unlit leaves the PBR route, mapping to BasicEffect with lighting off or to SkinnedEffect with white ambient and no directional light.
tokens: all-white ambient and no directional light

concepts.text: The material record keeps base colour, metallic, roughness, emissive and emissive strength, IOR and specular factors, normal scale, occlusion strength, alpha mode/cutoff, double-sidedness, seven texture slots, UV selectors, per-map transforms, samplers and colour-space intent.
Rigid and skinned PBR effects receive the same shared parameter convention.
tokens: Rigid and skinned PBR effects receive the same parameter convention

concepts.text: glTF samplers map exactly onto XNA TextureFilter (all eight min/mag/mip combinations) and Clamp/Mirror/Wrap, stored per part; a mipmapped minFilter on single-level PNG/JPEG images is reported.
concepts.note: Samplers were structurally absent in the older importer.

concepts.text: Transmission is approximated as alpha = 1 - factor; specular-glossiness is converted (diffuse->base colour, metallic 0, roughness 1-glossiness) dropping the specular factor.

Punctual lights: at most three, all approximated as directional (point/spot aimed at the origin), color*intensity clamped, range and cone ignored, each loss counted; a file without lights renders black under PbrEffect defaults until the app sets lighting.
An untextured SkinnedEffect part gets a 1x1 white texture because XNA's skinned effect samples an unbound texture as black while glTF defines a missing base-colour texture as white.

The source-controlled extension registry of 21 records is the acceptance authority, with support levels Implemented, ImplementedWithNamedLimit, Approximated, ParsedButIgnored, Unsupported and NotDesired.
KHR_texture_transform is independent per map rather than baked into one UV stream.
KHR_materials_unlit, variants, IOR, emissive strength and core material factors are implemented (unlit and emissive strength with named limits).

KHR_materials_specular factors are consumed by every PBR renderer and its texture maps by eight families (not METAL); required use is still refused. The registry's prose lists seven of those families.
KHR_materials_transmission and archived specular-glossiness are named approximations and therefore not claimed when required.
KHR_lights_punctual is reduced to at most three directional approximations with range, cone and intensity losses reported.
KHR_draco_mesh_compression is claimed only when CNA was built with the decoder (CNA_ENABLE_DRACO, default on, off under Emscripten); Draco allows only triangle lists and strips.
PNG/JPEG fallbacks rescue textures also advertising KTX2/BasisU or WebP; without a fallback the map is dropped and named.
Clearcoat, sheen and volume are parsed but ignored by stock effects, while their factors are copied onto the material for the engine layer's glTF material bridge.
EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing imports one placement per node and reports the lost per-instance transforms.
Cameras and material variants are preserved through CNAEXT Model properties on the direct path.
GltfImportReportEXT carries scene counts and ordered diagnostics with stable codes, severity, kind, subject, count, worst magnitude and details on both direct and converter-produced CNJ routes.
AnythingLost() is true when any warning diagnostic exists; dropped and approximation counts sum occurrence counts; consumers must branch on Code, not message text.
Keep parsed, represented, reported and drawn-by-this-renderer as separate claims.
tokens: parsed, represented on the model, reported in the import report, and drawn by the renderer you ship

concepts.text: The core throws std::runtime_error for semantic rejections such as an undefined primitive mode, an attribute count mismatch, an out-of-range index or a skin over 72 joints.

Claim that the runtime reader lets such failures escape as bare std::runtime_error: ContentManager::Load<T> wraps any std::exception from a loose reader in ContentLoadException with the original as inner exception.
concepts.note: The exception asymmetry the claim describes was closed on 2026-09-01; a catch of ContentLoadException now sees glTF import failures.

concepts.text: The offline converter prints error: <message> and exits with status 1 on any conversion failure.
On success the runtime creates bones, meshes, parts, buffers, effects, textures, skinning, rigid-clip and morph records in one private bundle attached to the raw-pointer Model.
Images are cached by source image for one import, with a separate cache for occlusion images remapped for DualTextureEffect.
Claim that repeated primitives always receive their own effects: effects are shared per material, skin, shape and UV mapping (including variant overrides), while buffers stay per primitive.
Each glTF mesh placement becomes one ModelMesh with one part per primitive and one bounding sphere, named after the mesh (plus node name when placed several times).
Across loads, sharing is the ContentManager cache: a second Load in one manager returns the same graph; another manager decodes again.
tokens: a second manager decodes everything again

concepts.text: Cameras are imported by walking the scene graph, so one camera instanced by two nodes is two placements; missing zfar gives an infinite projection, orthographic uses twice the half extents, an absent aspect is recorded as assumed.

issues.text: The doc comment above ReadGltfModel still says only the first mesh group is imported and unitScale has no runtime equivalent; the code imports every group. Stale source comment.
The glTF extension registry note for KHR_materials_specular lists seven renderer families sampling both maps; the test inventory lists eight (WebGPU included). Stale registry prose.
EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing: only one placement per node is imported; per-instance transforms are dropped (reported).
Runtime glTF import has no unit-scale control (fixed 1.0); only the offline converters scale.
asset.version is checked only when present; asset.minVersion is not inspected.
The former asymmetry where glTF extraction errors escaped Load<Model> as std::runtime_error is absent at TARGET: Load<T> wraps them in ContentLoadException (commit cd6587084).
glTF import errors escaping catch(ContentLoadException): narrowed at TARGET — Load<T> wraps loose-reader std::exception in ContentLoadException; direct core callers still receive std::runtime_error.
Runtime UV-set mismatch is reported at TARGET (uv-set-mismatch diagnostic and warning).
glTF structural validation and extensionsRequired enforcement exist at TARGET.
